drift_receipt.interpretation: Catalogue-version drift: the DYFI/ComCat window count changed by 1 between observations (e.g. 7575 -> 7576). This is expected catalogue evolution (a revision entering the window), which is why the outcome-bearing snapshot must be pinned to one access instant and hash-locked; a count from one instant must never be paired with a payload fetched at another.
